improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and professional business guidance — powered by Claude. Try three free searches and see the difference."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately introduces the product name and its core function, building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional guidance) while clearly communicating the risk-free trial offer. The phrase 'see the difference' creates subtle curiosity without making unsubstantiated claims. Copy is concise and action-oriented to drive trial engagement.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be prompted to select a membership plan to continue. Choose from US$2 or US$7 per day, billed monthly or annually—with annual plans saving you 30 percent. Your membership unlocks unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your personal members workspace.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in the conversion funnel—what happens at the paywall. By clearly explaining the transition from free trial to paid membership and restating the pricing options, it reduces uncertainty, builds trust, and nudges visitors toward conversion with transparent information.
